name: Clear the Way
label: Quest
description: Clear the Way: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With Andorhal's western and northern roads into the city well fortified, I'm looking to strike at it from the less defended eastern road. The Scourge relies on the buffer of undead that infests Sorrow Hill as a first line of defense. If we are to advance on Andorhal, we will need to do it through Sorrow Hill.
Your first assignment will be to clear the way through Sorrow Hill. Thin out the skeletons and ghouls that haunt the area; report back to me when this is done!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I want you to prepare for the worst, friend - dig deep. The task in front of us will not be easy. As we rally our forces here to eventually strike out against the Scourge, you will be part of our advance effort that takes the fight to them! Your assigned mission in Sorrow Hill will begin our path to victory!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mission accomplished, friend! Well played, well played.

Allow me to reward your work thus far with some coin from the Stormwind coffers. I'd recommend spending it on materiel that will aid you in your next mission... One that will take you into the ruins of Andorhal itself.
